title: Tailscale is not resolvable from any candidate path -> blocked with an install hint
titleZh: 所有候选位置都找不到 Tailscale -> blocked,并给出安装提示
why: tailscale.exe is resolved through the registry install entry, Program Files, Program Files (x86), LOCALAPPDATA and PATH, in that order (printed by -Describe). This case uses the fixture's tools hook, which is the only honest way to express 'not installed' offline: MEASURED, environment redirection cannot do it, because Windows PowerShell 5.1 re-creates %ProgramFiles% inside the child process (a parent pointing ProgramFiles/LOCALAPPDATA/PATH at empty temp dirs still resolves the real install path). The whole point of the verdict is that a missing prerequisite is a hard stop with a stated remedy and a way back, and that the collector itself installs nothing.
inject: fixture declares tools.tailscale as absent, so the candidate chain resolves nothing
expectSummary: TAILSCALE_CLI_LAYER blocked/ts_not_installed with command + rollback, config tool.tailscale empty/'missing', exit 2
